title: Katsura Imperial Villa
scope: The standing Shoin main residence with its open courtyard, the named Gepparō and Shōkintei teahouses, and the Omotemon front gate at Katsura Imperial Villa.
limitations: The main residence’s documented building sequence and overall perimeter are fixed. Exact internal roof junctions, heights, gate width and details away from the photographed views are estimates.
Only the main residence, Gepparō, Shōkintei and Omotemon are represented. Other tea houses, walls and garden structures are outside this model.
